answer: Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, which means the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. The ember receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 90 aliases trips the duplicate check at the shale gate. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a violet seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under.
